title: Generic measured fixed-size variable deletion for guarded SAT
claims: ExactVariableDeletionSAT checks exact canonical domain recognition and satisfiability after deleting a fixed number of variables into any sublist-closed guarded P base.
MeasuredVariableDeletionSAT gives a paired structural and residual machine with exact canonical semantics.
ExactHornVariableDeletionSAT and ExactRenamableHornVariableDeletionSAT check the exact guard and SAT languages for their respective bases.
HornVariableDeletionSATSearch and RenamableHornVariableDeletionSATSearch recover sparse satisfying assignments with encoded length at most the input length.

experiments.purpose: Bind the archived Lean modules and exact statements to the recorded local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports zero Lean invocations and can be complemented by replay with the pinned reference.
